aircraft_registration: Belgian aircraft registration: OO- and three letters, like `OO-SNA`, or the forms for microlights (`OO-I36`), paramotors (`OO-1AB`) and home-built aircraft (`OO-123`).
amount_eur: Amount in euros, written the Belgian way: € before it, or €, EUR or euro(s) after it in any case, the thousands split by dots or by spaces (the same throughout), and a comma before the cents or `,-`, like `€ 1.234,56`, `1 249,99 euros` or `250 EUR`.
bancontact_card: Bancontact card number (Belgian debit card, bankkaart): 17 digits starting with 6703, with or without spaces or dashes, like `6703 1234 5678 9012 1`.
bban: Old Belgian bank account number (BBAN, rekeningnummer, numéro de compte) from before IBAN: 12 digits written `539-0075470-34`, with both dashes.
bic: BIC (SWIFT code) of a Belgian bank: four letters, BE and a two-character location code with a B or a digit in it (`BB`, `22`, `B1`), with an optional three-character branch code, like `GEBABEBB` or `KREDBEBBXXX`.
birth_date: Date of birth with its marker, marker included: `°`, `geboren (te Gent) op`, `geb. (am)`, `né(e) (à Liège) le`, `born on`, `geboortedatum`, `date de naissance`, `DOB`, then a date like `° 3/2/1990`.
bis_number: Belgian BIS number (bisnummer, numéro bis): 11 digits written like the national number, `85.27.30-033.71` or without dots and dash, with the birth month raised by 20 or 40.
bpost_tracking_number: bpost parcel barcode (track-and-trace number, code de suivi): 24 digits starting with 3232 or 3299, 18 digits starting with 3232, or JJBEA and 22 digits, like `323256984521032569`.
company_name: Belgian company name: up to nine capitalized words on one line followed by a legal form (BV, BVBA, NV, CV, CVBA, VZW, VOF, CommV, SRL, SPRL, SA, SC, ASBL, SNC), like `Janssens Bouw BV`; not across a sentence's full stop, and not `Uw CV` or `votre CV` (a curriculum vitae).
date_numeric: Date with the day first, the Belgian way: day, month and a 2- or 4-digit year separated by the same `/`, `.` or `-`, like `12/01/2024` or `3.2.24`; not inside a longer run of numbers such as `06.12.34.56.78`.
date_text: Date with the month written out in Dutch, French or German, in any case and also without its accent (`fevrier`, `Maerz`), like `12 januari 2024`, `1er mars 2023` or `3. März 2022`.
docket_number: Belgian court docket number (rolnummer, numéro de rôle), label included if any: `2026/AR/1234` or `2026/AB/123` (appeal and labour courts), Cassation's `P.24.0123.N`, and after AR, R.G. or rolnummer `AR 26/1234/A`.
domain_be: Belgian domain name ending in .be, .brussels, .vlaanderen or .gent, in any case, with its subdomains, like `www.politie.be` or `stad.brussels`; email addresses like `jan@test.be` and longer names like `test.be.com` do not match.
driving_licence_number: Belgian driving licence number (rijbewijsnummer, numéro de permis de conduire): the 10 digits after their label, keyword included, like `rijbewijs nr. 0123456789`.
ecli: European Case Law Identifier (ECLI) of a Belgian court decision: ECLI:BE:, the court, the year and the number, like `ECLI:BE:CASS:2020:ARR.20200115.1`.
eid_card_number: Belgian eID card number (kaartnummer van de identiteitskaart, numéro de carte d'identité): 12 digits, written `592-1234567-32` or without the dashes.
enterprise_number: Belgian enterprise number (ondernemingsnummer, numéro d'entreprise, KBO/BCE): 10 digits starting with 0 or 1, with or without dots, like `0123.456.749`.
establishment_number: Belgian establishment unit number (vestigingseenheidsnummer, numéro d'unité d'établissement): 10 digits starting with 2 to 8, like `2.123.456.791`.
iban: Belgian IBAN: BE, two check digits and 12 digits, with or without spaces, like `BE68 5390 0754 7034`.
iccid: SIM card number (ICCID) of a Belgian SIM: 8932 followed by 14 to 16 digits, without spaces, like `89320112345678901232`.
imsi: IMSI (subscriber identity on a SIM) of a Belgian network: mobile country code 206 and 12 more digits, 15 in all, like `206011234567890`.
license_plate: Belgian license plate (nummerplaat, plaque d'immatriculation): `1-ABC-123` since 2010, with or without dashes, and the older `ABC-123` and `123-ABC` with their dash.
mobile_number: Belgian mobile number (gsm-nummer): 04xx, +32 4xx or 0032 4xx (also `+32 (0)4xx`) and six digits, with spaces, dots or slashes or none, like `0470 12 34 56`; only valid Belgian mobile numbers, not part of a longer run of digit groups.
mrz_id_card: Machine-readable zone (MRZ) of a Belgian identity card, first line (ICAO TD1): 30 characters with BEL as issuing country, like `IDBEL592123456<782<<<<<<<<<<<<`.
mrz_passport: Machine-readable zone (MRZ) of a Belgian passport, second line (ICAO TD3): 44 characters with the passport number, BEL as nationality, date of birth, sex and expiry date.
msisdn: Belgian mobile number in MSISDN form, as in telecom records: 32 and the number without its 0 and without a +, 11 digits like `32470123456`; only valid Belgian mobile numbers.
national_number: Belgian national register number (rijksregisternummer, numéro de registre national): 11 digits, birth date first (month 00 to 12), like `85.07.30-033.28` or `85073003328`.
notice_number: Belgian prosecutor's file number (notitienummer, numéro de notice) after its label, keyword included: the PV number's form, like `Notitienummer: AN55.L1.012345/26`, or a slash form like `GE/D/43/12/1234/2024`.
passport_number: Belgian passport number (paspoortnummer, numéro de passeport): two capital letters and six digits, like `EH123456`.
phone_number: Belgian phone number, landline or mobile: 0, +32 or 0032 (also `+32 (0)`) and 8 or 9 digits, with spaces, dots or slashes or none, like `02/234.56.78`; only valid Belgian numbers, not part of a longer run of digit groups.
postal_code_city: Belgian postal code (postcode, code postal) and municipality on the same line: four digits and one or more capitalized words, or a name in capitals, like `9000 Gent`, `9100 Sint-Niklaas` or `1000 BRUXELLES`; not a Dutch postcode like `1234 AB`.
premium_number: Belgian premium-rate (090x) or shared-cost (070) number, with or without spaces, dots or slashes, like `0900 12 345` or `070 22 33 44`; only valid Belgian numbers.
pv_number: Belgian police report number (pv-nummer, numéro de PV), also the notitienummer of the case it opens: parket code, offence code, police unit, number and year, like `AN.55.LB.000123/2026` or `HA55.L1.012345/16`.
street_address_fr: Street address in French: Rue, Avenue (Av.), Chaussée, Place, Boulevard (Bd), Chemin, Quai or Square, the name and a house number of up to four digits, with the box (bte) if given, like `Rue de la Loi 16 bte 2`.
street_address_nl: Street address in Dutch: a name ending in straat, laan, steenweg, plein, lei, dreef, weg, baan, kaai or markt, a house number of up to four digits and the box (bus) if given, like `Kerkstraat 12 bus 3`.
structured_communication: Belgian structured payment reference (gestructureerde mededeling, communication structurée, OGM/VCS): 12 digits as `+++123/4567/89002+++`, or with `***` at both ends.
time: Time of day as written in Belgium: hour 0 to 23 and minutes with `u`, `h` (either case) or `:` in between, and seconds if given, like `14u30`, `9h05` or `23:59:30`; not a part of a MAC or IPv6 address.
vat_number: Belgian VAT number (btw-nummer, numéro de TVA): BE and the 10-digit enterprise number, with or without a space and dots, like `BE0123.456.749`.
